title: The number of Tverberg partitions beyond prime powers
summary: Sierksma's conjecture asserts that every affine map $a\colonΔ_{(d+1)(r-1)}\longrightarrow\mathbb{R}^d$ has at least $((r-1)!)^d$ unordered Tverberg partitions into $r$ parts. Until now, lower bounds growing with $d$ were known only when $r$ is a prime power.
